Package neqsim.process.equipment.ejector

Class EjectorOperatingPoint

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.ejector.EjectorOperatingPoint
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EjectorOperatingPoint extends Object implements Serializable
Operating point of a fixed-geometry ejector as calculated by EjectorFixedGeometrySolver.

All flows are mass flows in kg/s and all pressures are in bara. The suction flow is a result of the calculation (the entrainment capacity of the fixed geometry at the given conditions), not an input.

Version:
1.0
Author:
esol
